evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-13"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-13". A todo created without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date has no time part, and a datetime string was rejected (see AC3).
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 200 and the new date. PATCH /todos/3 and /todos/1 with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null. A later GET /todos showed the changes persisted.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "13/10/2026", "2026-10-13T10:00:00Z" and the number 5 each returned 400 with 'dueDate must be a valid date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null'. PATCH with "2026-02-30" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-14. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only todo 4 (undone, due 2026-10-01). Todos excluded from it: due today (2026-10-14, overdue:false), future-dated, no due date (overdue:false), and done with a past date (id 5, due 2026-01-01, overdue:false after PATCH done:true).
evidence.AC5: The page at / showed 'today fällig: 2026-10-14', 'nodue fällig: 2026-10-01 überfällig' and 'pastdone ✓ fällig: 2026-01-01'. Todos without a due date showed no date.
evidence.AC6: Only the overdue todo (due 2026-10-01, not done) showed 'überfällig'. The due-today, no-due-date and done-with-past-date items did not.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. Before clicking it, the list showed 5 todos. After clicking it, the list showed only 'nodue fällig: 2026-10-01 überfällig'.
